Message:
Me, Yubera, Fia...
All of us bore the same pain.

Unable to forgive ourselves,
sacrificing our own lives
is the only way we can seek to
atone for what we’ve done...

That must be why we feel
so drawn to one another.

Fia went to visit Yubera
almost every day,
gazing on at the girl
as she continued to paint.

I had no idea how
heartwrenching a past
lay depicted in that painting.

But the landscape she painted,
imbued with her
very own life essence,
was hauntingly beautiful.

The crumbling city looks like
something out of a dream,
but also seems
familiar somehow...

Even that collapsing house
looks just like—

It’s the exact landscape
I’ve witnessed countless times
in my dreams...
of the very city I destroyed...
